## 🏆 𝟭, 𝟮, 𝟯 ... 𝟰 𝗪𝗜𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗥𝗦 ! 𝗜𝗻𝗰𝗹𝘂𝗱𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟭𝘀𝘁 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝗰𝗲 ! 🫅
 
**🌟 𝗠𝗜𝗡𝗗. 𝗕𝗟𝗢𝗪𝗡 !!! 🌟**

We are delighted and proud to announce that 𝟰 𝘁𝗲𝗮𝗺𝘀 from last weekend's Hugging Face 𝗟𝗲𝗥𝗼𝗯𝗼𝘁 𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗹𝗱𝗪𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗛𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻 hosted in 42 Paris have made it to the 𝗧𝗢𝗣𝟯𝟬 𝗼𝗳 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿'𝘀 𝗲𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻, including the winner and 3rd place ! 🦾 

After one wild day of public voting on LeRobot's Discord, the public has finally made its decision ... and boy, that was tight until the end ! Thanks to the 42 community worldwide for their mobilization !

👨‍🍳 𝗟𝗲𝗖𝗵𝗲𝗳 𝗶𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿'𝘀 𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘄𝗶𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗿 🏆 ! 

➕ 𝗟𝗲𝗦𝗽𝗹𝗮𝘁 𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗱 𝘁𝗼 𝗹𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹 𝘂𝗽 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗽𝗹𝗮𝗰𝗲 !🥉 

2 teams on the podium ... a result that goes beyond our wildest expectations ! 😁 💫 

Check out the list of the 30 winning projects announced this morning and their videos 
👇

<a class="b-link" target=_blank href="https://huggingface.co/spaces/LeRobot-worldwide-hackathon/all-winners">The 30 Winners Video Submissions</a>

Let's showcase our winners' works ! 

### #1 🏆 : 🧑‍🍳  𝗟𝗲𝗖𝗵𝗲𝗳 - 𝗬𝗼𝘂𝗿 𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝘀𝗮𝗻𝗱𝘄𝗶𝗰𝗵-𝗺𝗮𝗸𝗲𝗿 ! 🥪 

LeRobot on a linear rail system to enhance its movement, using a customized base ACT model implementing conditional logic, with an LLM-powered interface which literally allows you to talk your way to your favorite sandwich ! 

Huge congratulations to **Thomas Gossin, Imad Sidhoum, Badr Kebrit and Leonardo Chiodi** !!! 

On top of the world ! 🌎 👏👏👏

### #3🥉: 𝗟𝗲𝗦𝗽𝗹𝗮𝘁 : 𝟯𝗗-𝗴𝗲𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗿𝘆 𝗶𝗻𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗲𝗱 𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗮𝘂𝗴𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 ➕

Making the training of robot policies more robust against small camera displacements by synthesizing novel views and adding them to the dataset.

Tremendous work by **Arne Vandendorpe, Jérémy Keusters, Jan Verheyen and Niels Rogge** that will benefit the whole LeRobot ecosystem ! 👏👏👏

### #13🏅: 𝗟𝗲𝗖𝘆𝗯𝗼𝗿𝗴 : 𝟯𝗿𝗱 𝗔𝗿𝗺 𝗖𝘆𝗯𝗲𝗿𝗻𝗲𝘁𝗶𝗰 𝗘𝗻𝗵𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 🦾 

by **Erwan Martin and Baptiste Lubrano Lavadera** 👏👏👏

A custom dataset created using a wearable SO100 arm attached to a backpack, equipped with both a wrist camera and a context camera. 

A MyoWare EMG sensor was used to record muscle activity from the user, which data was incorporated into the observation space of the robot, in order to make the robot react to the user's muscle contractions/activity. 

### #23🏅 : 𝗟𝗲𝗟𝗮𝗯 : 𝗔 𝗪𝗲𝗯 𝗜𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗮𝗰𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝗟𝗲𝗥𝗼𝗯𝗼𝘁 🖥️ 

by **Alba María Téllez Fernández, Nicolas Rabault, Victor Oldensand and Adam Kadmani** 👏👏👏

LeLab is a simple, user-friendly web wrapper for leRobot, designed to make physical AI accessible to everyone — almost no terminal needed. 

Contribute to the project on their HuggingFace space and make AI Robotics even more accessible to everyone using LeLab !
